newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair plans Lappeenranta-St Petersburg route.
newsitem.headline: Finnair plans Lappeenranta-St Petersburg route.

text.p: Finnnish national carrier Finnair Oy said on Thursday it would start regular scheduled flights to Saint Petersburg from the southeastern Finnish town of Lappeenranta on a trial basis this April.

"The new route will be flown on a trial basis five days a week from the beginning of April to June 21 and, after a brief midsummer break, again from August 17 until the end of October," Finnair said in a statement.
Service will be provided with a 34-seat aircraft, and the evening flights will originate in Helsinki, Finnair said.
